site.title: rs-learn
site.tagline: continual-learning primitives · wasm cdylib · plugkit host
site.description: continual-learning primitives for LLM agents, shipped as a small wasm cdylib: rank-2 hebbian microlora, ewc++ consolidation, bi-temporal knowledge graph with 8-head attention, and a fastgrnn router. the host owns io, scheduling, embedding, and agent transport.

hero.heading: rs-learn
hero.subheading: // continual-learning primitives · wasm cdylib · plugkit host
hero.body: continual-learning primitives for LLM agents, shipped as a small wasm cdylib that runs inside a host providing key-value storage and vector search via a handful of imports. this crate is the algorithm layer — the host owns io, scheduling, embedding, and agent transport.

lines.text: host_kv_put(ns, key, val) -> u32      // nonzero = ok
host_kv_query(ns, query) -> u64        // json array of matches
rs_learn_dispatch(ptr, len) -> u64     // packed json response

items.name: hebbian microlora
items.desc: rank-2 hebbian adapter, norm-bound, lr floor, |scale|-weighted prioritized replay, optional ewc correction.

items.name: ewc++ consolidation
items.desc: online fisher ema (decay 0.999); z-score boundary detection over a sliding loss window.

items.name: bi-temporal graph
items.desc: valid_at/invalid_at/created_at/expired_at edge store; point-in-time query; invalidate-don't-delete contradiction handling.

items.name: graph attention
items.desc: 8-head attention with edge features: relation one-hot, recency decay, weight. per-head softmax weights.

items.name: fastgrnn router
items.desc: 90% sparse + rank-8 low-rank; five heads (model, context bucket, temperature, top_p, confidence); epsilon-greedy exploration.

items.name: single json dispatch surface
items.desc: one verb table maps to all five cores; wasm export wires rs_learn_dispatch to a singleton LearnSession backed by the host's kv shim.

sections.label: dispatch // verbs
sections.heading: one json surface, five cores.
sections.body: every call is { verb, body } in, { ok, verb, data?, error? } out. the host passes an in-buffer and reads the response from the packed return.

items.name: health
items.sub: reports core readiness, fisher key count, boundary count.

items.name: init_instant · feedback · apply_adapter · reset_adapter
items.sub: microlora lifecycle: initialize targets, hebbian update on feedback, forward pass, zero-reset.

items.name: record_loss · consolidate · ewc_penalty
items.sub: loss ring + z-score boundary fire, fisher ema update, penalty computation against a params snapshot.

items.name: init_router · route · record_outcome
items.sub: initialize fastgrnn, choose model + sampling params, ema-update per-target quality.

items.name: init_attention · attend
items.sub: initialize 8-head attention, compute a multi-head attended context vector over a subgraph.

items.name: insert_edge · query_at · invalidate_edge · contradict · get_edge
items.sub: bi-temporal edge crud plus graphiti-style contradiction handling.

sections.label: graph // bi-temporal model
sections.heading: contradictions never delete history.
sections.body: edges carry four timestamps: valid_at/invalid_at (when the fact held in the world) and created_at/expired_at (when we knew it). a point-in-time query at t returns edges where valid_at <= t < invalid_at. when fact b contradicts fact a starting at t = b.valid_at, we set a.invalid_at = t and a.expired_at = now — a stays queryable for any time before t. the canonical test walks the alice@acme to alice@globex scenario and witnesses both edges retrievable at their respective historical windows.

sections.label: learn // hebbian microlora
sections.heading: rank-2 adapter, updated on every feedback call.
sections.body: instant_core::InstantCore keeps a rank-2 hebbian adapter (A: 2 x IN, B: 2 x n_targets). feedback(emb, model, {quality}) runs a five-step update.

items.name: centered scale
items.sub: quality [0,1] maps to scale = (q - 0.5) * 2. neutral feedback (q ~ 0.5) is a no-op.

items.name: hebbian update
items.sub: updates A and B for the chosen target, scaled by lr * scale.

items.name: ewc correction
items.sub: delta -= lr * lambda * fisher * (params - snapshot), when consolidation has run.

items.name: lr decay + floor
items.sub: lr decays by 0.995 per step, floored at RS_LEARN_LR_MIN (default 1e-3).

items.name: norm clamp + replay
items.sub: clamps ||A,B|| to 5.0; buffers (emb, idx, scale) for |scale|-weighted prioritized replay.

sections.label: ci // wasm-check + publish
sections.heading: wasm check on every pr, wasm publish on every push to main.
sections.body: wasm-check.yml runs cargo check against wasm32-wasip1 plus a native cargo test pass on every pull request. publish.yml builds the release wasm, auto-bumps the crate patch version, publishes the binary to the plugkit-bin github release, and pushes the npm wasm wrapper.

items.name: native test
items.sub: cargo test -p rs-learn — 65 tests covering every dispatch verb and algorithm invariant.

items.name: release wasm build + publish
items.sub: builds release wasm, uploads rs-learn.wasm + sha256 to the plugkit-bin gh release, publishes @anentrypoint/rs-learn-wasm to npm.

sections.label: env // configuration
sections.heading: knobs the algorithm layer reads.
sections.body: the crate itself takes no environment configuration beyond the lr floor; everything else (backend selection, agent transport, scheduling) is the host's responsibility.

sections.label: footnote // why
sections.heading: the algorithm layer, not the whole agent.
sections.body: rs-learn provides lora optimization over time (in the spirit of ruvnet's sona) and a temporal knowledge graph (in the spirit of getzep's graphiti), as a small wasm cdylib any host can embed. it does not own io, scheduling, embedding, or agent transport — that's the host's job.

flow.heading: anatomy of a pipeline
flow.intro: every floosie pipeline is the same shape. read top-to-bottom; the bytes flow the same way.
flow.ascii:
┌──────────────┐
│   source     │   stdin · ws · acp · file · iter
└──────┬───────┘
       ▼
┌──────────────┐
│ typed chunk  │   { type, data, meta:{mime} }
└──────┬───────┘   ◌ 98 variants · auto-detected
       ▼
┌──────────────┐
│  transform   │   .through(gate · parallel · scan · …)
└──────┬───────┘   ◌ 14 operators · sflow under the hood
       ▼
┌──────────────┐
│ processor    │   { name, status, chunksIn, chunksOut }
└──────┬───────┘   ◌ idle → running → error|stopped
       ▼
┌──────────────┐
│    sink      │   ndjson · ws · acp · file · iter
└──────────────┘
